question: In a certain code language, 'FIELD' is coded as '41', 'WONDER' is coded as '84'. What is the code for 'SKILL' in that code language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

'FIELD' is coded as '41'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a3e945f2852daa2a8d4194955b2db49cc24ca057f02488dd409c7d01ce913595.png] 

And,

'WONDER' is coded as '84'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9de71dd0368d3b4086b8b823499f3a291f4ef9cf0f549a7b2578eb9a66ede646.png] 

Similarly,

'SKILL' is coded as

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/87080f442d08220a8fe4714d04a5750f1ea954d99f871be16c1e4751964e2515.png] 

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
